name: zvideo_blur_region_by_mode
description: zVideo::buff_BlurRegionByMode dispatches mode 1 to horizontal blur, mode 2 to vertical blur, and all other modes to combined blur.
known_limits: tier S status pending for the zVideo FX blur dispatcher; current evidence is tier C equivalence.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x48ea00 validates a fastcall tail dispatcher that forwards rectOrNull and mode unchanged: mode 1 jumps to 0x48e870, mode 2 to 0x48e670, and other modes to 0x48e380.
Native smoke zvideo_blur_region_by_mode_smoke verifies modes 1, 2, and 3 match the direct horizontal, vertical, and combined blur leaves.
